summary: Find the access-control holes that get shipped apps breached, before you ship.
signature: 10 rule codes, file and line on every finding
highlights: Every table in the public schema without row level security, named and located
Policies that are technically on but let everyone through - using (true), with check (true)
Service role keys sitting anywhere the browser can read them, including client components
Separates what is proven from what is pattern-matched, and never fails a build on a guess
requires: python3 (already on macOS and Linux). Reads your project files only. No network.
notes: Static analysis of migration files and source. Tables created through the Supabase dashboard rather than a migration are invisible to it, and a clean result is not a guarantee - the report says so itself.
